name: Soldier of Godrick
walkthrough: Tutorial boss. Parry or dodge and punish.

name: Margit the Fell Omen
walkthrough: Use Shackle x2 (from Patches). Summon Rogier. +3 weapon recommended.

name: Godrick the Grafted
walkthrough: Stay close in phase 1. Run away from tornado in phase 2. Summon Nepheli.

name: Red Wolf of Radagon
walkthrough: Fast boss. Use magic-resistant shield. Attack after his combo.

name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
walkthrough: Phase 1: kill glowing students. Phase 2: dodge summons, attack during cooldown.

name: Starscourge Radahn
walkthrough: Summon all NPCs. Use rot breath. Respec easy now.

name: Godskin Noble
walkthrough: Sleep pots let you critical hit. Pillar can block his roll.

name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
walkthrough: Use Serpent-Hunter spear. Weapon skill staggers him.

name: Morgott, the Omen King
walkthrough: Aggressive. Use shackle. Stay medium distance.

name: Fire Giant
walkthrough: Phase 1: attack his brace/leg. Phase 2: hit his hands/eye. Mountaintop on horse.

name: Godskin Duo
walkthrough: Use sleep pots. Put one to sleep, fight the other 1v1.

name: Maliketh, the Black Blade
walkthrough: Phase 1: stay close. Phase 2: stay under him. Use Blasphemous Claw to parry.

name: Gideon Ofnir
walkthrough: Interrupt spells. He dies fast if pressured.

name: Godfrey / Hoarah Loux
walkthrough: Phase 1: avoid stomp AoE. Phase 2: run from grabs. Attack after his lunges.

name: Radagon / Elden Beast
walkthrough: Radagon: holy resistance helps. Elden Beast: run toward it, not away.

name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
walkthrough: Waterfowl Dance: run away first 2 flurries, roll INTO last. Use Bloodhound Step. Mimic Tear helps.

name: Mohg, Lord of Blood
walkthrough: Use Purifying Crystal Tear. Stay close. Attack during his NIHIL chant.

name: Dragonlord Placidusax
walkthrough: Stay behind him. Run from nuke. Ancient Dragon's Lightning Strike destroys him.

name: Hoarah Loux the First Elden Lord
walkthrough: Phase 1: stay close. Phase 2: strafe and backstab.

name: Lichdragon Fortissax
walkthrough: Stay under him. Attack legs. Dodge lightning.

name: Ancestor Spirit
walkthrough: Attack head for bonus damage. Dodge the orbs.

name: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
walkthrough: Stay under head. Run from grab. Attack after teleport.

name: Valiant Gargoyles
walkthrough: Kill first fast before second joins. Strike damage works best.

name: Crucible Knight
walkthrough: Parry him. His attacks are telegraphed. Horn attack is easiest to parry.

name: Flying Dragon Agheel
walkthrough: Stay under him on Torrent. Attack legs. Bait fire breath.
